map_policy: requirements.json and acceptance/ were written from the statement only and committed (stage-1 freeze, manifest.w.json) before any candidate, decoy or hidden test existed.
prompt: In chunk.js (CommonJS), fix chunk(items, size) so that it meets every requirement below. R1: the last chunk may be shorter: chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) returns [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]. R2: size must be an integer >= 1 (Number.isSafeInteger); anything else (0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, '2') throws RangeError. R3: the input array is never modified and every returned chunk is a new array (never the input array itself). R4: items must be an array (Array.isArray); anything else (a string, a number, null, an array-like object) throws TypeError, and this check comes before the size check. R5: chunk([], 3) returns [] and exact multiples are unchanged: chunk([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) returns [[1, 2], [3, 4]].
